description: Fleet native-vs-ContamX comparison arms. Each arm mutates the platform's air_flow_paths JSON (field-mutating ops) and/or an engine-level parameter (oa_fraction / filter_efficiency), and both engines see the same mutation: native reads the mutated JSON; ContamX re-exports and re-solves the PRJ for field-mutating ops, or reuses the baseline solved field for engine-level ops.

respiratory.description: Respiratory aerosol: shipped airborne-pool settings (0.10/epoch settling + inactivation), HVAC filtration applied.

chemical_tracer.description: Conservative chemical/particulate surrogate: no inactivation or settling; HVAC filtration still applies on ducted paths.

ahu_casualty.description: Main habitability AHU casualty: largest-volume supply group cut to hvac_duty 0 (declared-state sibling of hull_state_audit's hvac_casualty_main_ahu).

night_setback.description: Night setback: every HVAC group and the top-level hvac_duty at 0.5.

ach_surge.description: Ventilation surge: every HVAC group's declared ach doubled.

zone_isolation.description: Zone isolation: every cross-zone link shut (dampers/hatches between ventilation zones closed).

hatches_closed.description: Internal hatches/doors shut: every passive adjacency path removed.

outdoor_air.description: Full outdoor air (purge): oa_fraction 1.0 — no recirculated mass returns through the AHU plenum (engine-level on both sides).

full_recirc.description: Full recirculation: oa_fraction 0.0 — maximum recirculated mixing (engine-level on both sides).

filter_merv13.description: Filter upgrade corner: filter_efficiency 0.50 -> 0.90, the Healthy Sail Panel's MERV-13 class figure (era-sweep corner, not a shipped value).
